name: Speedtest

intro.Ads: The banner and the ad after a speed test.
intro.Privacy: Trackers and permissions. They change nothing you see.
intro.App: Prompts the app shows by itself.

summary: Remove the ads from the internet speed test and stop its third-party trackers (Appvestor, CellRebel), without an account.

android.note: Speedtest 7.1.5 needs Android 9 (minSdk 28), but the x86_64 emulator needs arm64 translation, which google_apis images have from API 30 on (not API 33). The release tries the oldest supported version, the newest stable one and the next one; a pull request the oldest and the newest stable.

versions.phone_test: run a speed test on a phone: the emulator test only starts the app.
